class BugExample {

    public boolean showBug() {
        int[] array1 = {1, 2, 3};
        int[] array2 = {1, 2, 3};
        boolean areEqual = array1 == array2; // BUG: ArrayEquals
        areEqual = array1 == array2; // Mutated line
        return areEqual;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BugExample bugExample = new BugExample();
        System.out.println("The arrays are equal: " + bugExample.showBug());
    }
}

class ArrayHashCodeBug {

    public int showBug() {
        int[] array = {1, 2, 3};
        int hashCode = array.hashCode(); // BUG: ArrayHashCode
        boolean condition = getCondition();
        if (condition) {
            for (; false;) {
                // unreachable code
            }
        }
        return hashCode;
    }

    private boolean getCondition() {
        return false; // the condition is always false

import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;

class AsyncFunctionReturnsNullBug {
    public static CompletableFuture<String> asyncFunction() {
        boolean unreachableLoop = false; // Mutation: Unreachable for loop
        do {
            // This for loop will never be executed, hence making it unreachable
            for (int i = 0; false; i++) {
                // Do nothing
            }
        } while (unreachableLoop);
        return null; // AsyncFunction should not return a null CompletableFuture
    }

    public static String showBug() throws ExecutionException, InterruptedException {
        CompletableFuture<String> future = asyncFunction();
        return future.get();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws ExecutionException, InterruptedException {
        showBug();
    }
}

class Bar implements Comparable<Bar> {
    private int value;
    private boolean condition;

    public Bar(int value, boolean condition) {
        this.value = value;
        this.condition = condition;
    }

    @Override
    public int compareTo(Bar other) {
        if (this.condition) {
            return Integer.compare(this.value, other.getValue());
        } else {
            // Unreachable if-else statement

                return 0;

                return 1;

    }

import java.lang.Exception;

class BugExample {
    private Exception deadException;
    private boolean isExceptionThrown;

    public BugExample() {
        this.deadException = new Exception("Dead Exception"); // BUG: DeadException
        this.isExceptionThrown = false;
    }

    public Exception showBug() {
        if (!isExceptionThrown) {
            for (int i = 0; false; i++) {
                // The for-loop condition is always false, making it unreachable.
            }
            this.isExceptionThrown = true;
            throw this.deadException;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BugExample bugExample = new BugExample();
        bugExample.showBug();
    }
}

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;

class DurationTemporalUnitBug {

    public void showBug() {
        Duration.of(1, ChronoUnit.YEARS); // BUG: DurationTemporalUnit

        // Unreachable for loop
        for (int i = 0; false; i++) {
            // code inside this block will never be executed
            // It's purpose is to prevent any compilation error caused by an unreachable statement
            if (i == 0) {
                System.out.println("This code is unreachable");
            }
        }
    }
}

import java.util.*;

class EqualsHashCodeBug {

    static class Person {
        private String name;
        private int age;

        public Person(String name, int age) {
            this.name = name;
            this.age = age;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass()!= o.getClass()) return false;
            Person person = (Person) o;
            return age == person.age && Objects.equals(name, person.name);
        }

        // Mutated version of the equals() method
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass()!= o.getClass()) return false;
            Person person = (Person) o;
            return age == person.age;
            // The duplicated statement
            Objects.equals(name, person.name);
        }

        public static void main(String[] args) {
            Person p1 = new Person("John", 25);
            Person p2 = new Person("John", 25);
            Set<Person> personSet = new HashSet<>();
            personSet.add(p1);
            personSet.add(p2);
            System.out.println(personSet.size()); // Outputs 2, should be 1
        }
    }
}

import java.util.*;

class EqualsHashCodeBug {

    static class Person {
        private String name;
        private int age;

        public Person(String name, int age) {
            this.name = name;
            this.age = age;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass()!= o.getClass()) return false;
            Person person = (Person) o;
            return age == person.age && Objects.equals(name, person.name);
            return age == person.age && Objects.equals(name, person.name); // Mutation
        }
        // BUG: EqualsHashCode

        public static void main(String[] args) {
            Person p1 = new Person("John", 25);
            Person p2 = new Person("John", 25);
            Set<Person> personSet = new HashSet<>();
            personSet.add(p1);
            personSet.add(p2);
            System.out.println(personSet.size()); // Outputs 2, should be 1
        }
    }
}

import java.util.*;

class EqualsHashCodeBug {

    static class Person {
        private String name;
        private int age;

        public Person(String name, int age) {
            this.name = name;
            this.age = age;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass()!= o.getClass()) return false;
            Person person = (Person) o;
            return age == person.age && Objects.equals(name, person.name);

            // Mutation generated by Duplication operator
            if (this == o) return true;
        }

        public static void main(String[] args) {
            Person p1 = new Person("John", 25);
            Person p2 = new Person("John", 25);
            Set<Person> personSet = new HashSet<>();
            personSet.add(p1);
            personSet.add(p2);
            System.out.println(personSet.size()); // Outputs 2, should be 1
        }
    }
}

import java.util.*;

class EqualsHashCodeBug {

    static class Person {
        private String name;
        private int age;

        public Person(String name, int age) {
            this.name = name;
            this.age = age;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass()!= o.getClass()) return false;
            Person person = (Person) o;
            return age == person.age && Objects.equals(name, person.name);

            // Unreachable for loop mutant
            boolean conditionFor = false;
            for (int i = 0; conditionFor; i++) {
                System.out.println("This code is unreachable for loop mutant.");
            }
        }

        public static void main(String[] args) {
            Person p1 = new Person("John", 25);
            Person p2 = new Person("John", 25);
            Set<Person> personSet = new HashSet<>();
            personSet.add(p1);
            personSet.add(p2);
            System.out.println(personSet.size()); // Outputs 2, should be 1
        }
    }
}

        double nan = Double.NaN;
        boolean equal = nan == nan;  // BUG: EqualsNaN
        System.out.println("Using == NaN comparison: " + equal);

        // Unreachable while loop mutant

            equal = nan == nan;
